## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (73%)** · Confident · Careful review
Singleton 90% conformal set [F1] with suspected margin involvement [F13], though InSitu remains at 26%.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 73%, InSitu 26%, Benign 1% | Favors Invasive over InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 100th percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Reliable input, atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive, 2/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed neighborhood; nearest is InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest model push (+1.03) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check accuracy · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Second-strongest push (+0.43) [F3], but 3/20 AI spot-check accuracy · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (-0.01) push toward invasive (+0.33) [F4]; 18/20 spot-checked, caption-inconsistent · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.22) with 18/20 AI spot-check accuracy · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 4, 5, 8) · context · 72% tumor cells [F7], 2876/mm² [F8] (97th percentile); size CV 93rd [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (0.0008; 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions represent InSitu carcinoma (26% probability; nearest neighbor BACH_0070 is InSitu, differing in unreliable mitoses and necrosis).
- Duct-confined atypia (regions 2, 6) predominates without stromal invasion, or frozen-section artifact distorts small nuclei (39 µm² [F9]).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 8, 1, 9**: Highest risk (0.96–1.00); confirm stromal invasion versus InSitu and verify unreliable mitoses/necrosis.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8**: Verify suspected tumor at medial (430 µm), superior (108 µm), and inferior (108 µm) margins.
3. **Regions 2, 6, 11**: Compare duct-confined atypia (2, 6) and scarce tubules (11) against high-risk areas.

found: 'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).
The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
